item.title: Live Updates: China’s Xi Warns Trump on Taiwan at Beijing Summit
item.description: Xi Jinping, China’s leader, told President Trump that Taiwan, if handled poorly, could lead to a clash with the United States. The two leaders are also expected to discuss trade and the Iran war at the two-day summit.

item.title: Russia Pummels Kyiv After Putin Hints That War Could End Soon
item.description: At least one person was killed and dozens were wounded in a drone and missile strike, the latest in a series of attacks since a three-day truce expired on Monday.

item.title: Top Gaza Negotiator Urges Hamas to Embrace Rebuilding Plan
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov, who is overseeing the U.S.-led truce in Gaza, has tried to convince the militant group to give up its arms, but it has so far refused amid Israeli cease-fire violations.

item.title: Gulf Countries Arrest Shiite ‘Traitors’ Amid War With Iran
item.description: Dozens of Gulf citizens have been accused of belonging to Iran-linked terrorism cells as the war accelerates a shift toward deeper authoritarianism in the region.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine War Shows Cease-Fires Have Lost Meaning Under Trump
item.description: Temporary truces have become a tool of performative diplomacy, an end in themselves rather than a prelude to a lasting settlement, analysts say.

item.title: Duterte Ally Flees to Evade I.C.C. Arrest Warrant After Chaos at Philippine Senate
item.description: Senator Ronald dela Rosa, who is wanted by the International Criminal Court in The Hague, had been holed up in the building when shots rang out.
